meta.note: Built from the product briefs; the GitHub repository DilshanMP/wedding-planner was not readable from this session.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: the ivory ground every screen sits on. Evening is the Wedding Day Mode and night-time ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, drawers, table bodies. Separated from surface by a `line` hairline plus shadow-sm, never by colour alone.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Soft beige wells: table headers, input fills on raised cards, skeleton blocks, the inactive track of a progress bar.

tokens.name: champagne-100
tokens.usage: Champagne tint: selected rows, active nav item ground, the hover of a ghost button, the Premium quote label ground.

tokens.name: champagne-300
tokens.usage: Decorative champagne: journey rail between stages, chart series for 'committed', ornament rules. Never text.

tokens.name: champagne-500
tokens.usage: Champagne gold accent fill: the countdown ring, a stage in progress, the gold of the cover. Decorative only on ivory (2.7:1) — not for text.

tokens.name: champagne-700
tokens.usage: Champagne text: overlines, the 'Premium' label, figures that should feel golden. On surface, surface-raised and champagne-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: wine-50
tokens.usage: Wine tint: bride-side group ground, a selected tab's pill, the Best Value label ground.

tokens.name: wine-600
tokens.usage: Wine red, the primary brand colour: primary buttons, active nav and tab indicators, links, the one key figure on a screen. Text on surface, surface-raised and wine-50.

tokens.name: wine-700
tokens.usage: Wine pressed/hover state for primary buttons and links.

tokens.name: on-wine
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a wine-600 or wine-700 fill (dark in Evening, where wine is lightened).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on every surface and tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, table meta, helper text. On surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and champagne-100.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders of cards, table rows and dividers (decorative: never the only cue for a control).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons. 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: sage-50
tokens.usage: The subtle natural green as a ground: completed journey stages, 'within plan' budget rows.

tokens.name: sage-600
tokens.usage: Natural green text and marks: completed stage ticks, leaf ornaments. On surface, surface-raised and sage-50.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state: Paid, Confirmed, Booked, Completed. Leans teal so it never relies on red-vs-green; always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: success-50
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and notices.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning state: Pending, Waiting, trending over plan, payment due soon.

tokens.name: warning-50
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges and notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive state: Overdue, Declined, over budget, delete. Brighter vermilion than the wine brand; always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-50
tokens.usage: Ground for danger badges and notices.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: Sent, Delivered, Opened, Quoted, tips from budget intelligence.

tokens.name: info-50
tokens.usage: Ground for info badges and notices.

tokens.name: bride
tokens.usage: Bride-side guests: chips, chart series, side markers. Always with the word 'Bride' or initial.

tokens.name: groom
tokens.usage: Groom-side guests: chips, chart series, side markers. Blue-slate so it reads apart from bride for colour-blind viewers. Always with the word 'Groom'.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Wedding Day Mode's current time only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero and the simulator's chapter titles.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Countdown and the one emotional headline per screen.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section titles, modal titles, card headlines that carry emotion.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Key money and count figures on stat cards (lining numerals).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, drawer titles, functional headings.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Plan every detail, control every rupee, and enjoy the journey.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs, onboarding questions, empty-state messages.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, form labels, nav items.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Table cells, meta lines, helper text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrows above figures and section titles; set uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding (md); table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; gap inside card stacks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; card padding on hero cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Landing page section rhythm (mobile).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Landing page section rhythm (desktop); Wedding Day Mode breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small tags, table action buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, vendor cards, notices.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers' leading corners, hero cards, the mobile bottom nav.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, side chips, progress bars, segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards, with a `line` hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus, popovers, the mobile bottom nav.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: From here: two-column dashboards, collapsed icon sidebar replaces the bottom nav.

tokens.name: bp-laptop
tokens.usage: From here: full sidebar with labels, drawers instead of full-screen sheets.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Content max width; three-column dashboard grid.
